body:
# Ai /abs Official Minecraft Server Modpack

Welcome to the official modpack for the Ai /abs Minecraft community server from El Salvador.

This pack was built to create a more complete multiplayer experience without losing the core feeling of Minecraft. The focus is on performance, exploration, building, quality-of-life improvements, and community gameplay.

## What the modpack includes

* Improved world generation and exploration
* Performance optimizations for lower-end and mid-range PCs
* Better multiplayer and server-side compatibility
* Enhanced building and decoration options
* UI and inventory quality-of-life improvements
* New biomes, structures, and progression systems
* Carefully selected mods to keep gameplay stable and coherent

## Server focus

This modpack is designed specifically for the Ai /abs community server experience:

* Community projects
* Survival multiplayer
* Collaborative builds
* Events and seasonal activities
* Long-term progression

The goal is to keep the pack accessible while still offering enough content to make the server feel distinct from vanilla Minecraft.
